limitations: One bounded ABBA run with two repetitions per version; no confidence interval or claim of exhaustion of all optimizations.
Measured warm native stdio observations of already completed operator/Python jobs; not HTTP capacity, job launch throughput, or large-stream bandwidth.
Source stdout payloads are only 44-48 bytes; a 16 KiB read limit does not turn this into a 16 KiB transfer benchmark.
Sampled process-tree RSS/FD/CPU and descendant peaks may miss short-lived activity; PermissionError samples were retained and reported separately.
Descendant counts are sampled discovered PIDs without executable classification; an exact SSH-only child peak is unavailable.
Zero observed child survivors covers only sampled process identities and is not an exhaustive proof that no process could survive.
Resource peaks cover a controller's whole lifetime and cannot be assigned to an individual concurrency cell.
Throughput and latency include host/network effects; ABBA mitigates order effects but does not establish statistical significance.
Normal controller restart only; abrupt controller death, new-job idempotency, target reboot, physical power loss, and WAN partition require separate evidence.

method.call_balance: Equal status/read calls across the six original completed jobs in every cell.
method.controller_cpu: Sum of same PID/start-ticks /proc PID stat utime+stime deltas divided by total calls.
method.latency: Nearest-rank quantiles over all individual call durations from both repetitions, including any failed calls.
method.sampled_resources: 100 ms process-tree samples over entire controller lifetime, including warmup and shutdown; not per-concurrency peaks.
method.scope: operator Python backend; completed jobs; warm observations; normal controller restart
method.throughput: Total calls (or successful calls) divided by sum of complete cell elapsed seconds; no mean of cell rates.
method.transport: native stdio MCP, one concurrent session per controller
method.warmup: Six complete output reads before each timed round; startup and restart excluded from cell timing.

removed: controller process IDs and birth ticks
retained: all recorded sampling error classes and sanitized messages
